Developer handoffDownloads and Figma

Decided rules and tokens win. Figma follows them.

Hub/Build/Developer handoff
Build

Developer handoff.

What the unifiedmeds website, the assessment, the product screens, the emails and the landing pages are built from, which pages are in scope, how to use the tokens and where the release checklist and the change path live.

Build from Figma frames Page scope Tokens Before a release Feedback labels How changes arrive

What you build from.

Five sources. Decided rules and tokens win (R-01); the designer's Figma is the source only for what is not decided yet, and our own Figma files follow the rules. If the build, this hub and a Figma file disagree, raise a QUESTION.

  1. tokens/tokens.json and brand.css

    Every colour, size, space, radius, shadow, duration and easing. brand.css is generated from tokens.json. Link it first, never edit it, never hard-code a value it holds.

  2. components.css · reference components

    Buttons and their hover matrix, links, fields, checkboxes, answer options and choice cards, the capsule progress and loader, cards, chips, step numbers, the header, the footer, feedback states and interactive states. Port the rules, not necessarily the class names. Specimens: Components.

  3. The rulebook

    Rulebook & decisions (same text as brand-rules.md): every rule, decision and exception in the rulebook, and the open items. Cite rules by ID in tickets.

  4. Figma frames

    Layout, content and hierarchy for each page, where a rule does not already decide it. The one frame list: Website pages · Figma frames. Read with Dev Mode.

  5. Motion on Motion

    The M-set (M-001 to M-024) is the only motion reference (R-54). Every card uses --motion-* tokens.

Figma frames.

One frame list for the whole site, with the notes where a frame differs from a rule: Website pages · Figma frames. Two frames are already overruled: the header logo is 52 on desktop and the Primary seal 50 on mobile (R-103, not 30 / 26), and the footer is the one on Mist (R-48, R-114), not the Deep Teal footer the designer's file still shows. Build both from Components.

Never use links to the three Figma files moved to trash on 08.10.2026 (keys starting Csrbx…, ILQVN… and yimfrn…).

Page scope.

The launch: Sexual health with Tadalafil, Sildenafil and Combo, the assessment, the product screens, the emails and the landing pages. Longevity and Hair loss are designed and follow after launch (Phase 2, U-04). Every new page starts from the page spec in Templates, with its Mobile (390) differences and its approvers. An earlier site build in Astro (October 2026) exists as a reference; ask Avi for it and decide whether to reuse it (U-09).

How to use the tokens.

Each token path in tokens.json becomes one CSS custom property in brand.css. Dots become dashes, and a short prefix names the group.

Token pathCSS custom propertyValue
color.surface.paper--color-surface-paper#FEFCF6 · the page
color.brand.deep-teal--color-brand-deep-teal#264653 · primary ink, dark sections (the footer is on Mist, R-48)
color.text.secondary--color-text-secondary#55747F · Slate, captions and labels
color.line.field--color-line-field#55747F · field boundary
typography.desktop.hero--type-desktop-hero-family, -size, -weight, -line, -trackingDM Serif Display 46 / 54
typography.mobile.label--type-mobile-label-*Inter SemiBold 11 / 16, +2%
space.4--space-416px
layout.content-max--layout-content-max1240px
radius.small--radius-small12px
size.control--size-control50px · every button and field
shadow.overlay--shadow-overlayThe only shadow: dropdowns and dialogs
motion.duration.open--motion-duration-open220ms
motion.easing.ui--motion-easing-uicubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1) · ease-out
motion.distance.lift--motion-distance-lift2px · button hover lift (R-41); Pressed, cards and menu rows never lift (R-99, R-43)

.btn {
  height: var(--size-control);

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .hero h1 { font: var(--type-mobile-hero-weight) var(--type-mobile-hero-size) / var(--type-mobile-hero-line) var(--type-mobile-hero-family); }
}

Prefer semantic tokens.

Use --color-text-*, --color-surface-* and --color-line-* where they exist. Use --color-brand-* only for brand surfaces, shapes and button fills.

Reduced motion comes with the tokens.

brand.css sets every --motion-duration-* and distance to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Script-driven motion must check the same media query.

Fonts.

DM Serif Display and Inter 400 to 700 from Google Fonts, with display=swap. No other face, except a monospace on internal screens.

A value is missing.

Do not invent it. Raise a QUESTION. The answer becomes a decision and a token before it is built.

Before a release.

One coded checklist for everything that ships (R-123): How we work · The pre-publish checklist. Developers run the Brand, Compliance, Accessibility and Discretion blocks on every page they change, plus the Dev block (Dev1 to Dev9), and write the codes in the approval log.

What the Dev block covers.

tools/check.py at 0 problems; widths 1440, 1024, 768 and 390; values from tokens only; only logged exceptions (E-02 header button 44, E-03 mobile bar 48, E-04 and E-05); focus; keyboard and touch; reduced motion; no link to Phase 2 pages before launch; no stand-in photo.

Required lines.

"Assessment only. Not a diagnosis." next to every assessment CTA above the fold and in the mobile bar (R-63); a licensed provider named wherever a next step is offered (R-64); the consultation line under a hero button (R-62); "Prescription treatment is subject to provider approval. Results vary." under every treatment list; safety information fully expanded (R-66); DEMO ONLY on any demo screen (R-69).

Feedback labels.

Start every review comment with one label. The label decides where it goes and who acts. The same four labels are used in every review (How we work).

LabelUse it whenWhere it goesWhat happens
BUGThe build does not match the rules, the tokens or our Figma files.Website backlog, with the page, breakpoint, Figma node and rule ID.The developer fixes the code. No rule or token changes.
CHANGESomeone wants a value or a rule to be different.A proposed decision for Avi in the decision log.Build to the current rule until Avi decides. If approved, it takes change path 1.
ADOPTSomething built works better than the spec and should become the rule.A proposed decision for Avi in the decision log, with a link to the built example.If approved, it takes change path 1 and our Figma files follow. Until then it is not the rule.
QUESTIONThe spec is missing or unclear, or two sources disagree.Open items, with one owner.The owner answers. Keep building everything the question does not block.

Website backlog tool: To confirm

How a change reaches developers.

A rule or a value changes on one path, always in the same order: decision, brand-rules.md, tokens, changelog, release. The full path, and the second path for approving a finished asset, are on How we work · Two change paths.

What you pull.

The new tokens/tokens.json and brand.css, and components.css if a component changed. The changelog lists the date, the decision and rule IDs, the tokens that changed and the pages affected. Then run the checklist on those pages.

No silent mismatches.

If a Figma file, the hub and the build disagree, raise a QUESTION the same day. Never copy a value from Figma by eye when a token exists, and never build a value that has no token.
